{{Top|leg}}
'''Float wrestling''' was a competitive sport that involved matches organized by the [[Pan-Galactic Float Wrestling Syndicate]]. At the [[Galactic Center Spaceport]]'s [[Arrival Lobby 757]] in [[44 ABY]], the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Bazel Warv]], [[Seff Hellin]], and [[Vaala Razelle]]'s cover story for [[Liberation of Coruscant (Lost Tribe of Sith emergence)|arriving]] at [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] was to compete in a championship match at the [[Iblis Globe]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. Warv posed as the rising [[Ramoan]] wrestler "Jade Masher," while the [[Human/Legends|Human]] Hellin was his manager and Razelle served as the latter's [[Arcona/Legends|Arcona]] assistant.<ref name="Apocalypse">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Apocalypse]]''</ref>
